text:
maya: Quick heads-up — kicking off a config-only canary for routing + batching tweak. Change window open now until 11:10 PT, canary at 10% for 10m.

deploy-bot: `deploybot start --type=config-canary --id=cb-1757654321 --cohort=10% --duration=600s --changes=route+batch`

aj: Noted. I'll watch p99 latency and kv-cache miss rate. If p99 > 350ms or error rate > 0.5% we rollback immediately.

sam: Can you paste the config payload so I can validate against the linter?

maya: here it is — small JSON tweak, defaults + tenant override for high-volume tenants:

```json
{
  "batch_window_ms": 8,
  "max_concurrency": 48,
  "routing_policy": "latency-first",
  "kv_cache": { "prefix_cache_ttl_s": 180 },
  "tenant_overrides": {
    "search-prod": { "pin_to_profile": "stable-v1", "cohort_exclude": true }
  }
}
```

luca: LGTM for defaults. Recommend we pin search-prod to stable-v1 for the canary (avoids noisy traffic). I'll apply the tenant pin now.

aj: Thanks — I'll also create a temporary alert: if tokens/s tail drops >20% or overall tokens/sec drops 15% then trigger rollback hook.

deploy-bot: canary cb-1757654321: started. 5 targets, initial health 5/5. Metrics reporting interval 30s.

maya: :eyes: Leaving note — ensure fallback routing exists to the previous policy if we hit capacity cliffs.

sam: Rollback command is `deploybot rollback cb-1757654321` (tested in staging). Also drafting release-note blurb: "Config: batch_window -> 8ms, max_concurrency -> 48, routing policy bias towards latency; search-prod pinned to stable-v1 during rollout."

aj: 10m check — p99 +12ms, errors 0.12%, kv-cache miss steady. Proceed to ramp? propose 50% over 30m.

luca: No objections. Keep search-prod pinned until ramp completes. I'll add the sticky pin to the canary ticket.

deploy-bot: canary cb-1757654321: 10m pass. Promoting to ramp=50% over 30m. changelog id changelog-8987.

maya: I'll update release notes and add the rollback playbook to the ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
